record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.context_brief: Albanese fibers under pseudo-effective tangent bundle
record.original_question: Let X be a compact Kähler manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. After replacing X by an appropriate finite étale cover, consider the Albanese map X → Alb(X) and a fiber F. Can one prove that the anti-canonical divisor −K_F is big or that F is projective? Is the Albanese map itself an MRC fibration of X?

evidence.quote: Toward structure theorems for compact Kähler manifolds X with pseudo-effective tangent bundle, it was proved in [35, Theorem 3.12] that the Albanese map X → Alb(X) satisfies a similar conclusion to Theorem 4.2. The next problem is to prove the projectivity of fibers.

Problem 4.5. — Let X be a compact Kähler manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. After we replace X with an appropriate finite étale covering of X, we consider the Albanese map X → Alb(X). • Can we prove that the anti-canonical divisor −KF is big or F is projective? • Is the Albanese map X → Alb(X) an MRC fibration of X?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold whose holomorphic tangent bundle $T_X$ is pseudo-effective (i.e., the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(T_X^*)}(1)$ on the projectivization of $T_X^*$ is pseudo-effective). Let $\mathrm{alb}: X \to \mathrm{Alb}(X)$ denote the Albanese morphism of $X$, and let $F$ denote a general fiber of $\mathrm{alb}$.

After replacing $X$ by a suitable finite étale cover (and accordingly replacing $\mathrm{alb}$ and $F$), establish the following:

(a) Show that the anti-canonical divisor $-K_F$ of $F$ is big, or, more strongly, that $F$ is a projective manifold.

(b) Show that the Albanese map $\mathrm{alb}: X \to \mathrm{Alb}(X)$ is a maximal rationally connected (MRC) fibration of $X$; that is, its general fiber is rationally connected and any rational curve in $X$ that meets a general fiber is contained in that fiber.
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerns the structure of compact Kähler (non-projective) manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. In the projective case, Hosono–Iwai–Matsumura and Cao–Höring established structure theorems giving MRC-type fibrations. In the Kähler setting, projectivity of Albanese fibers and the MRC interpretation remain difficult because the Albanese map is not projective and positivity of direct images is not directly available. Recent work (e.g., on Kähler threefolds with nef anti-canonical bundle, and on Albanese maps for Kähler manifolds with nef anticanonical bundle, 2023–2025) makes partial progress in special dimensions/curvature settings, but the general problem for compact Kähler manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on positively curved projective varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 4.5 asks, for a compact Kähler manifold X with pseudo-effective tangent bundle, whether after étale cover the Albanese fiber F has -K_F big or is projective, and whether the Albanese map is an MRC fibration.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Compact Kähler three-folds with nef anti-canonical bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a structure theorem for compact Kähler threefolds with nef anti-canonical bundle, extending Cao–Höring in dimension 3.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress in dimension 3 under a stronger curvature hypothesis.

status_evidence.title: Albanese map for Kähler manifolds with nef anticanonical bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the Albanese map in the Kähler setting with nef anticanonical bundle.
status_evidence.claim: Related recent progress on Albanese maps in the Kähler case, but not resolving the pseudo-effective tangent bundle problem in general.
